answer_2.quote: For the objective evaluation, F0 frame error (FFE) and mel-cepstral distortion (MCD) were used to measure the reconstruction performance of different VAEs. FFE combined the Gross Pitch Error (GPE) and the Voicing Decision Error (VDE) and was used to evaluate the reconstruction of the F0 track. MCD evaluated the timbral distortion, which was computed from the first 13 MFCCs in our experiments. Moreover, word error rates (WER) from an ASR model trained on the real speech from the LibriTTS training set were reported.

answer_4.quote: First of all, a subjective listening test was performed over 11 synthesized audios with 23 volunteers asked to rate the naturalness of speech samples on a 5-scale mean opinion score (MOS) evaluation. The MOS results were reported with 95% confidence intervals. In addition, an AB test was conducted to compare the CU-enhanced CVAE with utterance-specific prior and normal CVAE with standard Gaussian prior. 23 volunteers were asked to choose the preference audio generated by different models in the AB test.
answer_4.guideline: rate the naturalness of speech samples on a 5-scale mean opinion score (MOS) evaluation; choose the preference audio generated by different models in the AB test
